name: High-strength steel pipelines and automatic welding
aliases: High-strength steel pipelines and automatic welding
principle: Higher steel grades (X70, X80) allow thinner walls or higher pressure for the same pipe, and mechanised gas-metal-arc welding speeds joint making on long lines. In the UK, about 889 km of DN1200 X80 pipe was laid between 2000 and 2010 at design pressures of 90 to 94 bar, and a consultant study estimated a 22.7% cost saving over X65.
